title: Fixed Long Guide and Continuous Chain Hand Saw
description: One independently authored complete static portable chain-saw exterior. A whole long round-nosed blunt guide plate carries one entire continuous thick perimeter chain appearance with integral small blunt edge blocks. Its rear root enters a compact newly shaped power case, with one whole wrapping front grip, an actual open rear grip/trigger, a fixed front shield, blank side cover and plain top cap. The whole lower case rests on a finite sole. There is no flat shoe, vertical reciprocating strip, upright circular disc or imported old tool component. All visible meshes are newly authored; generic closed-mesh and rendering helpers only are reused. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres, native Z up, horizontally centred ground datum. One prop, zero scenes. No sharp cutting edges, workpiece, power system, motor, chain motion, oil/fuel, cutting, braking/protection, handling, ergonomics, operation, assembly or engineering/safety performance. Static low-poly art only, not tool instructions. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
